today.lq.nearTitle: The last ten nights are near
today.lq.near.one: The last ten nights begin at sunset on day 20, in {n} day. Start preparing now: renew your intention, plan your nights and increase your worship.
today.lq.near.other: The last ten nights begin at sunset on day 20, in {n} days. Start preparing now: renew your intention, plan your nights and increase your worship.
today.lq.tonightTitle: The last ten nights begin tonight
today.lq.tonight: At sunset the 21st night begins, the first of the odd nights. Seek Laylatul Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten.
today.lq.eveTitle: The last ten nights begin at sunset
today.lq.eve: At sunset on day 20 the 21st night begins, the first of the odd nights. Seek Laylatul Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten.
today.lq.hereTitle: The last ten nights are here
today.lq.oddTonight: Tonight is night {n}, an odd night: it could be Laylatul Qadr. Pray as if this is the night, seek forgiveness and make dua with all your heart.
today.lq.oddNow: Night {n} continues until Fajr. It is an odd night: it could be Laylatul Qadr. Pray as if this is the night, seek forgiveness and make dua with all your heart.
today.lq.oddEve: Night {n} begins at sunset on day {d}. It is an odd night: it could be Laylatul Qadr. Pray as if this is the night, seek forgiveness and make dua with all your heart.
today.lq.evenTonight: Tonight is night {n}. Keep striving every night: the Prophet ﷺ strove in worship in the last ten nights more than at any other time.
today.lq.evenNow: Night {n} continues until Fajr. Keep striving every night: the Prophet ﷺ strove in worship in the last ten nights more than at any other time.
today.lq.evenEve: Night {n} begins at sunset on day {d}. Keep striving every night: the Prophet ﷺ strove in worship in the last ten nights more than at any other time.
today.lq.last: The ten nights are complete. Finish strong and keep up your good deeds to the very end.
today.list.title: Daily checklist
today.hayd.title: Sisters' mode
today.hayd.sub: On your period today? Prayer and fasting deeds are set aside and left out of your score.
today.hayd.ayah: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
today.hayd.tipsTitle: Your worship continues. Here is what you can focus on:
today.hayd.tip1: Increase dhikr, istighfar and salawat throughout the day
today.hayd.tip2: Make abundant dua, especially during the times of salah
today.hayd.tip3: Listen to Quran recitation and reflect on its meanings
today.hayd.tip4: Give charity: even a smile is sadaqah
today.hayd.tip6: Work on character, patience and gratitude
today.hayd.tip7: Morning and evening adhkar for protection
today.hayd.tip8: Make dua for others in their absence: the angel says "Amin, and for you the same"
today.toast.perfect: A perfect day, masha'Allah: every deed on your list is done.
today.toast.reminder: You haven't logged today's deeds yet. Every deed counts.
today.install.body: Add Ramadan Strivers to your home screen for quick access, even offline.
today.install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen to install Ramadan Strivers.
today.install.done: Ramadan Strivers was added to your home screen.
today.archive.title: A new Ramadan has begun
today.archive.body: Ramadan {year} AH has started. Move your Ramadan {old} AH days, Quran pages and journal entries to an archive and start fresh? Your badges and best streaks are kept. The archive stays on this device and is included when you export a backup.
today.archive.done: Ramadan {old} AH archived. A fresh start, bismillah.
today.archive.wait: Your Ramadan {old} AH days are still on this device. Choose whether to archive them before you start.

modes.year.fasting: You are fasting today. May Allah accept it.
modes.year.arafah: The Day of Arafah: a Sunnah fast with a great reward.
modes.year.ashura: The day of Ashura: a Sunnah fast.
modes.year.tasua: The 9th of Muharram (Tasu'a): a Sunnah fast, kept with Ashura.
modes.year.shawwal: A fast today counts toward your six days of Shawwal.
modes.fast.body: Mondays and Thursdays, the white days (the 13th, 14th and 15th of each Hijri month), the Day of Arafah, Tasu'a and Ashura (the 9th and 10th of Muharram) and six days of Shawwal.
modes.fast.today.arafah: Today is the Day of Arafah
modes.fast.today.ashura: Today is the day of Ashura
modes.fast.quote.arafah: The Prophet ﷺ said he hoped that fasting the Day of Arafah would expiate the sins of the year before it and the year after it.
modes.fast.quote.ashura: The Prophet ﷺ said he hoped that fasting the day of Ashura would expiate the sins of the year before it.
modes.fast.quote.tasua: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If I live until next year, I will certainly fast the ninth."
modes.fast.toggleOff: Adds today to your Sunnah fasts
modes.shawwal.quote: Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted the whole year.
modes.shawwal.done: Six days of Shawwal complete, masha'Allah.
modes.dh.kicker: First ten days of Dhul Hijjah
modes.dh.quote: There are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than these ten days.
modes.dh.hint: Mark each day you spent in extra worship, dhikr and good deeds.

me.cat.title: By category
me.rule.weekOne: Have at least one deed ticked on each of days 1 to 7.
me.rule.halfway: Have at least one deed ticked on each of days 1 to 15.
me.rule.fajrWarrior: Fajr ticked on 7 days in a row, ending on the day you tick a deed or the day before it. A day in sisters' mode ends the run, because Fajr is set aside that day.
me.rule.quranLover: Tick Quran recitation or reflection on any 15 days.
me.rule.generous: Tick giving charity or feeding a fasting person on any 10 days.
me.rule.abuBakr: Tick all four Abu Bakr challenge deeds on the same day.
me.rule.abuBakrG: Tick all four Abu Bakr challenge deeds on 3 different days.
me.rule.l10Hero: Checked when you tick on day 21 or later: at least 5 of days 21 to 30 have a saved record, and those records average 70% or more. A day where everything was unticked again counts as 0%.
me.rule.champion: Checked when you tick on day 21 or later: 60% or more on any 20 days of Ramadan.
me.guideEmpty: The guide is not available right now.

me.data.importBody: This backup has {days}, {pages} and {badges}. The days, Quran pages and journal entries in it replace the same days on this device; everything else on this device is kept.
me.data.reset1Body: This deletes everything the app keeps on this device: every day, badge, setting and journal entry, the Quran log, learning and Ramadan Prep progress and archived seasons. It also signs you out, removes your competitions from this device and turns off reminders here. An account and its cloud copy are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
me.data.reset2Body: Last check: all your progress on this device will be deleted permanently.
